svg.text: 7.3AH: literal-symbol same-run confirmation, +17.0% vs standard, +11.7% vs ranked paths plus anchors, 36/36 pass.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: 7.3AG: candidate screen only, +33.6% vs AE-R historical standard and +17.5% vs historical plus-anchors reference.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: 7.3AE-R: repaired public matrix, 48/48 pass; plus-anchors lane beat standard by roughly 19.5%.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: 7.3AA stays caveated: original matrix telemetry lacked clean uncached token fields.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
